subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and should it use `ignoreFileContent` or a different canonical media-ingestion policy name?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented Feishu config contract, and adding it changes plugin configuration and default media-ingestion behavior.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level/per-account Feishu option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Create or reuse one cross-channel attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want the same behavior beyond Feishu.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Document that Feishu currently supports only `mediaMaxMb` for this area and close or defer the opt-out request intentionally.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level/per-account Feishu option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the clearest recent merged history on Feishu media behavior and docs alignment.
